name: Volume series
description: This keyword returns the Volume of the selected Instrument for the selected timeframe. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Volume of the selected Instrument for the selected timeframe. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632310002.png)

The above conditon will return the previous 15min candle Volume of NIFTY 50 current month futures chart.

Please note that, Volume series cannot be used on spot as spot indexes dont have volumes, need to select futures chart
